scope: native ordinary unsplit linear handle_sof through normal return: dequeue/write decisions, effective frame keys, retention, current snapshot and writer errors
limitations: C++ containers, smart-pointer ownership, locking, DPCC and sensor writer are modeled boundaries.
Split gain/DCG, HDR, mirror changes, internal split-I2C path and native queue capacity are excluded.
Fixed Rust pending capacity is 32; effective records include failed writer attempts and do not establish physical application.
